_doc: The live many-to-many between the sixteen characters and the five authored pools in data/lore/. Pieces are written with no character in mind; candidates are marked afterwards, with a reason recorded in docs/worldbuilding/casting-ledger.md; cast is written last, in a casting session. Run `--report=casting` to see what is starved, orphaned, contested or forced. Provisional pool entries are scaffolding and are not cast.

_schema.locked: true once every one of the sixteen carries exactly one piece from this pool. Validation gets strict at that point.
_schema.pieces: piece id -> { candidates: [hero ids it could fit], cast: hero id or "" }
